program.text:
<program>
task: robot position on a 7 by 5 grid that wraps around
input: the moves in order
events: up down left right
x: 0..6
y: 0..4
start: x=5 y=0
on up: y+1 wrap
on down: y-1 wrap
on left: x-1 wrap
on right: x+1 wrap
answer: The robot is at column {x}, row {y}.
</program>
